title: Retention of Tuning for Vibro-Impact and Linear Dampers Under Periodic Excitation
content: This work studies the ability of a single-sided vibro-impact nonlinear energy sink (SSVI NES) and a tuned mass damper (TMD) to maintain their vibration reduction performance when the natural frequency of the primary structure (PS), which is determined by its stiffness, changes. Both types of dampers demonstrate high efficiency in mitigating the PS vibrations under periodic excitation if their parameters are optimized at a specific PS natural frequency. Their ability to reduce PS vibrations changes similarly for both types of dampers when this structural parameter is changed.
